`synthetic-colors-tone.mp4` is a non-private generated 3-second H.264/AAC MP4 (160×120): red, green and blue at one-second intervals, with a continuous 700 Hz tone and no speech. It contains no QQ content, credentials, provider responses or thought signatures.
